_comment: A clean map of salt-road-outline.json onto fifteen-beats: every quote is word for word from its chapter. The draft lacks the midpoint, the rising pressure and the dark night.

beats.evidence: weighs salt at dawn in the Lantern Guild's weighing house
a fair scale is only as honest as the hand on it
proud of a ledger she believes is fair
Bram is summoned to Karsk to answer for a short shipment
counts her coin twice, and almost refuses
swears the salt oath in her own name and takes the cart out onto the road
she meets Mara Quell, a Tidemark Combine buyer
learns to haggle, loses a cartwheel and wins a feud with a toll keeper
Ilse sells at the Karsk market
Her oath is struck and her cart is seized.
the hand on the scale was his
proves the tally false with Mara’s method
checks every hand on every scale

notes: Chapters 7 and 8 continue the market days; nothing in them raises the stakes.
